Previously viewed November 10–11 FVG evidence overlaps this sample; this is not an untouched prospective or out-of-sample strategy validation.

results.name: Opening range breakout
results.rules: Freeze the 09:30–09:44 range. First completed close ≥ 1 point above its high or below its low after 09:45. Enter next open, stop one ATR(14) from signal close, target 2R. One signal attempt per session.

results.name: VWAP reversion
results.rules: RTH-reset VWAP approximation uses typical price × minute volume. After 20 bars, require a close back inside its volume-weighted ±2σ band following an outside close. VWAP 5-bar slope must be ≤ 0.25 ATR(14). Stop beyond the signal extreme by 0.5 ATR; target signal-time VWAP, frozen. Require planned reward/risk ≥ 0.5.

results.name: Bollinger reversion
results.rules: 20-close SMA ±2 population standard deviations. Require a completed close back inside after an outside close, and 5-bar SMA slope ≤ 0.25 ATR(14). Stop beyond the signal extreme by 0.5 ATR; target signal-time SMA, frozen. Require planned reward/risk ≥ 0.5.

results.name: Opening range fade
results.rules: Freeze the 09:30–09:44 range. After a completed close outside by ≥ 1 point, wait for a close back inside. Fade toward the frozen range midpoint; stop 1 point beyond the excursion extreme. Require planned reward/risk ≥ 0.5. One signal attempt per session.

results.name: MNQ / MES spread
results.rules: Freeze integer MES hedge quantity from five earlier complete sessions using average notional values: 1 MNQ versus round(2×mean MNQ / (5×mean MES)) MES. Dollar spread = 2×MNQ − 5×MES quantity×MES. Cross ±2 on an RTH-reset rolling 60-close z-score to fade it; close at |z| ≤ 0.5, a mean crossing, $100 close-based net stop, 30 minutes, or 16:00. All fills next synchronized open. Both legs incur costs. This is a spread hypothesis, not a cointegration test.

results.name: Order flow / DOM scalping
results.data: Sequenced L2 updates + tape + queue model
results.rules: No order-book data was available. OHLC bars and trade volume cannot reconstruct resting depth, cancellations, queue priority, or tape timing. No hit rate or simulated DOM trades are generated.
results.reason: No historical L2 order-book updates or queue data were obtained.

rankingDefinition: Observed net-hit rate = trades with net P&L > 0 divided by all closed trades, including breakevens in the denominator. Sort only executed single-instrument variants by this sample statistic; the pair basket has a separate close-based fill model and is not ranked alongside intrabar-stop models. Wilson 95% intervals are descriptive binomial intervals and assume independent trials; intraday clustering and multiple strategy comparisons weaken inference.
limits: Only eight evaluation sessions. No strategy is established as superior or profitable in future markets.
No trained AI, hyperparameter search, or universal hit-rate estimate is involved. Each family contains many possible variants; these results describe only the written rules.
FVG variants are short-only; other single-instrument variants allow both directions. Signal frequencies, targets and exposure differ. Same dates/cost/risk budget do not make these identical bets.
Bar-based VWAP is approximated from typical price and minute volume; it is not a reconstruction of trade-level VWAP.
DOM was not backtested: no historical L2/queue dataset was obtained. Resting depth cannot be inferred from candles.

Pair spread is a fixed integer notional hedge with a rolling z-score; no cointegration or stability claim is made. It has next-open close-based exits, two-leg execution risk, and possible losses beyond its nominal stop budget.
Yahoo MNQ=F and MES=F front-contract feeds do not identify a dated contract month. No exchange-certified audit, broker fill validation, bid/ask spread, or queue model is available.
Single-instrument fills use adverse entry/stop slippage and assume target touch fills. Stop is checked first if stop and target occur in one bar. All values are simulated.
Risk $100 per trade, daily entry budget $300, maximum 3 contracts, assumed fee $1.24 round-trip per contract. Pair fee counts both legs. Account-specific Topstep drawdown rules are not tested.
Source hashes and deterministic reruns establish reproducibility, not that the vendor feed or model assumptions reflect executable prices.
